stem.text: The gaseous compound Z decomposes on heating.
In the diagram, Boltzmann distributions for Z at two different temperatures, P and Q, are shown. The lines X and Y indicate activation energies for the decomposition of Z with and without a catalyst.

stem.alt: Boltzmann distribution graph: number of molecules against molecular energy, curves P and Q, with lines X and Y marking activation energies

stem.text: Which curve and which line describe the decomposition of Z at a higher temperature and with a catalyst present?
